purpose: Ultra-global research registry for high-fidelity archival document image restoration, super-resolution, dewarping, denoising, binarization and OCR-aware enhancement. The goal is visually exceptional, faithful page masters rather than synthetic invention.

qualityTarget.engineeringMeaning: Very-high-resolution delivery where source resolution and geometry permit it; output resolution is not treated as proof of recovered factual detail.
qualityTarget.fidelityPriority: text and page fidelity over perceptual prettiness
neverClaim: 24K output means 24K source detail was recovered

newCandidates.name: SwinIR
newCandidates.notes: Classical and real-world SR plus denoising and JPEG artifact reduction; provides x2/x3/x4/x8 models and a mobile-oriented demo.

newCandidates.name: HAT
newCandidates.notes: High-performing transformer SR family; benchmark for fidelity versus perceptual sharpening and memory cost.

newCandidates.name: NAFNet
newCandidates.notes: Efficient restoration baseline; useful as a conservative deblur/denoise stage before OCR.

newCandidates.name: Restormer
newCandidates.notes: Efficient transformer for motion/defocus deblurring, denoising and deraining; useful for scan defects.

newCandidates.name: DiffBIR
newCandidates.notes: Diffusion-prior blind restoration and 8x SR; use only with a strict anti-hallucination gate for archival text.

newCandidates.name: SeeSR
newCandidates.notes: Semantics-aware real-world SR; weights reportedly Apache-2.0 in the official project, but benchmark text fidelity before archival use.

newCandidates.name: HYPIR
newCandidates.notes: Strong diffusion restoration research candidate, but current official distribution carries a non-commercial restriction; exclude from unrestricted production path unless permission changes.

newCandidates.name: SUPIR
newCandidates.notes: High-quality generative restoration; unsuitable for unrestricted archival production unless licensing is separately cleared.

newCandidates.name: TPGSR
newCandidates.notes: Text-prior guided SR; directly relevant because restoration is constrained by character structure and recognition.

newCandidates.name: TATT
newCandidates.notes: Text-attention SR designed for spatial deformation robustness; benchmark on Arabic glyphs and diacritics.

newCandidates.name: PEAN
newCandidates.notes: Diffusion-based prior-enhanced attention SR for scene text; candidate for text-centric reconstruction experiments.

newCandidates.name: STISR-TCDM / DiMSS
newCandidates.notes: Text-conditional diffusion SR; benchmark cautiously because conditioning can reconstruct plausible but incorrect glyphs.

newCandidates.name: RTSRN
newCandidates.notes: Robust text super-resolution research candidate for TextZoom-style evaluation.

newCandidates.name: DocRes
newCandidates.notes: Generalist document restoration covering dewarping, deshadowing, appearance, deblurring and binarization; strong fit for a unified archival pipeline.

newCandidates.name: DocNLC
newCandidates.notes: Multi-degradation document enhancement covering blur, noise, shadow, watermark and backgrounds.

newCandidates.name: UVDoc
newCandidates.notes: Neural grid-based document unwarping; published benchmark includes comparison against DewarpNet, DocTr, RDGR and DocGeoNet.

newCandidates.name: DocScanner
newCandidates.notes: Progressive learning for robust document image rectification; reports OCR CER and geometric metrics.

newCandidates.name: DewarpNet
newCandidates.notes: 3D+2D document unwarping baseline with OCR evaluation support.

newCandidates.name: DocTr++
newCandidates.notes: Rectifies distorted documents even when the whole page is not present in the image.

newCandidates.name: LA-DocFlatten
newCandidates.notes: Layout-aware document flattening; dataset license differs from code and must be audited separately.

newCandidates.name: Marior
newCandidates.notes: Margin removal and iterative content rectification for dewarping in the wild.

newCandidates.name: DocDiff
newCandidates.notes: Residual diffusion for document enhancement and binarization; evaluate against text fidelity and seal/detail preservation.

newCandidates.name: ScanTailor Advanced
newCandidates.notes: Mature deterministic book-scan cleanup, adaptive binarization, background/foreground separation and layout handling; excellent deterministic complement to neural restoration.

newCandidates.name: unpaper
newCandidates.notes: Deterministic cleanup for scanned pages and photocopies; can improve OCR input quality but must be visually reviewed.

newCandidates.name: OCRmyPDF image-processing
newCandidates.notes: Rotate, remove background, deskew and clean before OCR; can oversample DPI, but documentation warns that processing can introduce artifacts or quality loss.

promotionRules: No generative restoration may replace the immutable original.
A candidate that improves visual quality but increases OCR-CER or hallucinated-glyph-rate is rejected for archival text restoration.
24K-class output is a delivery target, never evidence of recovered historical detail.
Text-preservation benchmarks outrank generic photographic perceptual scores for books.
Every model weight and training dataset must pass a separate rights gate.
Neural and deterministic pipelines must be compared on the same source pages.
The best pipeline may be an ensemble or staged cascade rather than one engine.
Human approval is mandatory before an enhanced page becomes the archival derivative presented as faithful restoration.

sourceEvidence.name: SwinIR
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository documents x2/x3/x4/x8 SR, denoising and JPEG artifact reduction; Apache-2.0.

sourceEvidence.name: NAFNet
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository reports high restoration quality with substantially lower compute on cited benchmarks; MIT license.

sourceEvidence.name: Restormer
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository reports high-resolution restoration for deblurring, deraining and denoising; MIT license.

sourceEvidence.name: DiffBIR
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository provides blind restoration, 8x SR and Apache-2.0 code; model/asset terms remain separately gated.

sourceEvidence.name: SeeSR
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository provides real-world SR and Apache-2.0 code/weights statement.

sourceEvidence.name: HYPIR
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository states non-commercial-use condition for the software.

sourceEvidence.name: UVDoc
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository reports benchmarked unwarping and MIT license.

sourceEvidence.name: DocRes
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository unifies dewarping, deshadowing, appearance, deblurring and binarization and is MIT licensed.

sourceEvidence.name: ScanTailor Advanced
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository provides adaptive binarization and foreground/background splitting for scanned books; GPL-3.0.

sourceEvidence.name: unpaper
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official repository is specialized for scanned book pages and OCR preprocessing; GPLv2 with per-file exceptions.

sourceEvidence.name: OCRmyPDF
sourceEvidence.evidence: Official documentation warns that cleaning, background removal and rasterization can introduce artifacts and quality loss, and recommends visual review.
